description: Expands the fully exposed area covered by each Breach Light head.
Makes each Breach Light sweep its assigned arc faster.
Deploys more ROD drones per cast, with each drone able to return with a catch.
The size of the catch bar in the fishing minigame.
Deploys more Breach Lights at the same time.
Increases the chance that newly generated buried patterns belong to rarer species.
Keeps buried patterns exposed and reachable for longer after a Breach Light passes over them.
Widens the area around each Breach Light head where buried patterns appear as dents without being fully exposed.
Increases the slowing effect on surfaced patterns while they remain inside a Breach Light beam.
Increases ROD drone travel speed.
Makes ROD drones turn and adjust velocity more responsively.
Expands the visible fishing ring and the drones' base search reach.
Keeps a drone pursuing a pattern for longer before it abandons the chase and returns to the fishing ring.
Lets drones acquire and continue chasing patterns farther beyond the visible fishing ring.
Increases the chance that idle drones choose rarer available patterns before common ones when several are within reach.
Increases the number of ready harpoon shots the rig can hold.
Restores spent harpoon charges faster.
Increases harpoon projectile speed.
Widens the angle within which a harpoon shot snaps toward a valid pattern. It changes direction only and does not alter the chosen range.
How fast the meter fills while the window is on the fish.
How fast the meter drains while the window is off the fish.
